Data Analyst.description: Analyzes raw data to uncover insights, build dashboards, and support business decision-making.

Data Scientist.description: Applies statistical modeling, machine learning, and data analytics to solve complex business challenges.

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Designs, trains, deploys, and scales machine learning models into production software systems.

Python Developer.description: Builds backend architectures, robust REST APIs, microservices, and automation pipelines with Python.

Software Developer.description: Develops robust application software, applying algorithmic problem solving and solid engineering principles.

AI Engineer.description: Specializes in developing state-of-the-art AI solutions, generative AI, LLM integration, and neural architectures.

Full Stack Developer.description: Builds both user-facing modern frontend applications and performant backend services.

DevOps Engineer.description: Automates deployments, manages cloud infrastructure, and oversees continuous integration pipelines.
